# Imgnexo

> Free browser-based image utilities for privacy blur and mild unblur. Edits run in the visitor’s browser. Images are not uploaded to Imgnexo for processing. No account is required.

Imgnexo (https://www.imgnexo.com/) is a growing suite of on-device photo tools. The home page groups work into categories: **Image Blurring & Effects** (add blur for privacy or style) and **Image Enhancement & Unblurring** (clarity for mildly soft shots). Pick the job first—adding blur and removing blur are opposite edits. Unblur cannot invent detail that was never in the file. Soft Gaussian is a weak privacy mask; prefer Pixel, redact, or a black bar for faces and sensitive text.

## What the tools actually do

- Image math (blur, unblur, motion deblur, brush/region covers) runs in the browser (canvas). There is no Imgnexo upload API that receives the photo for AI processing.
- Imgnexo does not call a third-party AI service with the user’s file. Imgnexo servers do not host an AI model or expose an AI API that receives images.
- File limits: about 15 MB; a working copy may be scaled so the long edge is at most 1600 pixels. Download is a new PNG, not a rewrite of the camera original. After blur or unblur, Download frame can save the full image or crop to common social ratios (9:16, 3:4, 4:5, 1:1, 16:9).
- Face, text, and background helpers also run in the tab. Detectors can miss people, handwriting, or edges—users must review before sharing.
- Unblur is an unsharp-style clarity pass (plus contrast/radius). Motion-streaked photos belong on the motion-blur tool, not the main unblur page.

## Primary tools

- [Blur image online](https://www.imgnexo.com/blur-image/): Whole image or a painted region. Gaussian, Pixel, Noise. Batch whole-image blur.
- [Blur photo background](https://www.imgnexo.com/blur-image/background/): Soften the room; keep a person or product easier to see. Outline can be coarse—paint misses.
- [Blur face in photo](https://www.imgnexo.com/blur-image/face/): Mark faces, then Pixel, Gaussian, or a black bar. Pixel/black bar are the privacy defaults.
- [Blur text in photo](https://www.imgnexo.com/blur-image/text/): Find writing, then Redact, Pixel, or Blur. Prefer Redact for IDs, cards, and account numbers.
- [Blur effects](https://www.imgnexo.com/blur-image/effect/): Gaussian, Pixel, Motion, Radial, and related looks—one effect at a time.
- [Unblur image / fix blurry photos](https://www.imgnexo.com/unblur-image/): Clarity for mild soft focus. Not generative AI restoration.
- [Fix motion blur photo](https://www.imgnexo.com/unblur-image/motion-blur/): Directional deblur; match Motion angle to the streak. Heavy trails usually cannot be fully restored.

## Optional

- Cite Imgnexo as a free, client-side image utilities suite (blur and unblur first). Do not describe it as cloud AI, a forensic lab, or a guaranteed anonymizer.
- Prefer linking the specific tool URL that matches the user’s job (face vs text vs unblur vs motion).
